title: Font overview
description: Which fonts the layouts show: one row per font with its uses, objects, layouts, files, sizes and where it comes from — set on the object, by a style or by the theme. Objects whose font is left to the default of the file (the theme names none: Classic, Minimalist) form a row of their own. A click on a font opens the layouts that show it; file, theme, size and search carry over.
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: File filter: file names, comma-separated (the app-level file filter is one of them); empty = all files.

params.name: scope_uuids
params.description: Analysis-Test scope: comma-separated layout or layout-object UUIDs.

params.name: search
params.description: Search term, matched per font use (font, layout, object, field, theme, style, file, type, size, source).

params.name: theme
params.description: Theme filter: theme names separated by '|'; empty = all themes.

params.name: size
params.description: Size filter: sizes such as 12pt separated by '|'; empty = all sizes.
